raw_intent: Board decision: resolve the seal-commit path first. Provide a loop-sanctioned way for an already Checker-PASSED Trail to persist its seal without bypassing the existing git-write boundary or rewriting prior Trail history.
true_intent: Fix the discovered implementation gap: after a Checker PASS, seal.ps1 writes disposition.json but nothing can commit it (commit.ps1 refuses a trail that already has a disposition). Extend seal.ps1 to make one scoped, append-only, local commit of the seal (disposition.json plus any not-yet-committed frames of the same trail), never a push and never a modification of a prior committed frame. Implementation-gap only; no new sealing/replay/ACCEPT/LOOP semantics, no law/policy change, no seat authority change.
done_means: seal.ps1, after writing disposition.json, makes one local commit scoped to the trail; it stages only files under trails/NNNN-name, refuses if any staged change modifies a tracked trail file (Append-Only, LAW-010), refuses an absolute path (EC-0001), refuses unexpected staged changes outside the trail, and never pushes

proven able to fail on a fixture repo (real output): a normal seal commits disposition.json (exit 0); a modified prior frame is refused; an absolute path in a staged trail file is refused; a staged change outside the trail is refused
no company.json change, no law/policy change, no seat activation, no push, no install, no spend; Append-Only and Checker independence preserved
tools/build.ps1 stays deterministic and dotnet build and test still pass
do not use the new path on trails/0006 or claim AUDIT-PASS end to end; stop and report after the independent Checker
pace: one loop; stop at HANDOFF: CHECKER REQUIRED, then report
